title: Construction and Solar Electrification of Rural Primary Health Centres
description: Civil construction, rooftop solar PV micro-grid installation, and electrical distribution across 12 rural primary health centres.

requirements.title: CPWD / State PWD Contractor Registration
requirements.description: Bidder must hold valid Class-A or Class-I contractor registration with CPWD or State PWD.

requirements.title: Civil & Solar Works Experience
requirements.description: Executed at least 2 turnkey civil-cum-solar electrification projects in remote/rural areas.

requirements.title: Bank Solvency Certificate
requirements.description: Bank solvency certificate of minimum ₹1.5 Crore issued within last 6 months.
